title: Sliderino
excerpt: A fast visual editor for presentations, with a CLI and an MCP server that give external agents complete control.
content_html:
Sliderino

The smallest slide grammar
that work with agents.

A fast visual editor for presentations, with a CLI and an MCP server that give external agents complete control. Open-source, you own the files.

Sliderino 0.1.0

See it move

Sliderino in action

One editor, two authors

What a person can do,
an agent can do.

  1. 01

    Live edits, one undo history

    Agent changes show at once. Undo reverses the last step, from a person or an agent.

  2. 02

    Overflow you can see and read

    Text never shrinks by itself. The editor and get_diagnostics both report overflow.

  3. 03

    Tables, videos and shaders

    A small set of primitives: text, shapes, images, groups, tables and media fills.

  4. 04

    One file that you own

    A .sldr file holds the slides with their fonts, images and videos. No server.

  5. 05

    Editable pptx export

    Texts stay text, fonts are embedded, and shaders become videos that play.

Getting started

From zero to a live deck in four steps.

Sliderino runs on Linux and macOS. Shaders need a GPU. Videos need GStreamer.

  1. 1

    Install Sliderino

    Run the installer. It puts sliderino in ~/.local/bin.

    curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf \
  https://github.com/tncardoso/sliderino/releases/latest/download/sliderino-installer.sh | sh

    Then install GStreamer, which reads and plays videos:

    # Debian, Ubuntu
sudo apt install gstreamer1.0-plugins-base gstreamer1.0-plugins-good \
  gstreamer1.0-plugins-bad gstreamer1.0-libav

# macOS
brew install gstreamer
  2. 2

    Open the editor

    The Home screen opens. Press Ctrl+N for a new presentation or Ctrl+O to open a .sldr file.

    sliderino                 # the Home screen
sliderino deck.sldr       # open a file
  3. 3

    Connect your agent

    Add the MCP server to your client. The editor shows each connected client at the top of the window. For Claude Code:

    claude mcp add sliderino -- sliderino mcp

    Then ask

    Use the Sliderino MCP and make a presentation about Sliderino tools

  4. 4

    Or script it from the shell

    The CLI gives the same tools as MCP and writes JSON to stdout.

    sliderino info                                # slides, fonts, undo state
sliderino apply ops.json --label "Add KPIs"   # one undo step
sliderino screenshot -o slide.png             # render a slide to PNG
sliderino export-pptx deck.sldr -o deck.pptx  # editable PowerPoint
sliderino tools                               # list every tool

Make the next deck together.

$ sliderino
